title: Letter to Oskar Fevras
summary: Read to advance Free the Artist and learn the entrance phrase for Philgrave’s Mansion.

fields.Read: Advances Free the Artist toward Mystic Carrion. Say Secreta mortuorum at the mansion’s western wall to open the door. The wall can also be destroyed or lockpicked.
fields.Acquisition: Combine Oskar’s portrait with the empty easel in Lady Jannath’s atelier to reveal the chest behind the possessed portrait. The chest has a DC 20 lock.

changes: Added native BG3 quest and Inspiration uses verified against pinned item and quest revisions.
